name: Hurn
description: Leader of Clan Pearl of Storgard who became its military commander after Zilgeth's death.

description_citations.text: "Mina". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mariska gives the Fyndhorn Bow and Shield of the Ages to Jason Carthalion, and she and Hurn leave Storgard before its fall.
timeline.quote: Mariska and her husband left the city with Kjeldos before the Fall of Storgard

citation.text: "Mina", section "Mariska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oriel urges the Stone Council to leave Storgard, but they accuse her of blasphemy.
timeline.quote: As head of Clan Emerald , she urges the council to leave Storgard and bring their people to the south.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An explosion in Clan Emerald's quarters kills sixteen; Miko decrees a duel to the death between Jason and Freyalise.
timeline.quote: But Miko decrees that a magical duel must decide the conflict.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Twilight Kingdom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forty days later Miko lets the Emerald and Pearl clans leave and Jason's group heads south.
timeline.quote: Jason, Oriel, Mariska, Hurn, and four dozen other people start their walk to the south.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
